description: O06 G1 dependency lockfile (SBOM) for the glibc-side runtime closure required by the pinned Kron4ek Wine 11.14 amd64-wow64 archive and its source-rebuilt Android 16 KB dispatcher trio. Every glibc/X11 package is built from source via its pinned gpkg build script, so the loader and libraries come from one glibc 2.43-1 build (no loader/libc ABI skew). tools/build_glibc_closure.py produces 16 KB-congruent ELF segments; tools/check_wine_dtneeded.py verifies the actual closure. tools/build_wine_16k_ntdll.py source-rebuilds Unix ntdll.so plus PE ntdll.dll/win32u.dll as one matched set and rejects mixed dispatcher stubs. This covers the mandatory wineboot + X11/GDI closure; optional/dlopen-disablable dependencies remain outside this qualification.

target.elf_page_policy: All staged ELF64 PT_LOAD segments have p_align >= 0x4000 and congruent p_offset/p_vaddr modulo 0x4000. Built with -Wl,-z,max-page-size=0x4000; valid on both 4 KB and 16 KB Android kernels. Enforced by tools/stage_wine_runtime.py before packaging.
target.libc_namespace: glibc (separate from Android/Bionic; the Bionic namespace gets only the platform whitelist libc/libm/libdl/liblog/libpthread)
target.closure_basis: mandatory DT_NEEDED of Kron4ek Wine 11.14 amd64-wow64 (winex11.drv NtTerminateProcess'es if libX11.so.6 is absent)

wine_16k_dispatcher.staging_rule: All three outputs are mandatory and must be staged together; old 0x7ffe1000 x86_64 PE stubs are rejected.

packages.name: glibc
packages.role: the dynamic loader ld-linux-x86-64.so.2 + libc.so.6, libpthread.so.0, libdl.so.2, libm.so.6, librt.so.1, libresolv.so.2. Android patch set (SysV SHM, fakesyscall, passwd/group) is the full termux-pacman set.
packages.build_recipe: gpkg/glibc/build.sh + project overlays for Android-blocked poll(2), x86_64-only new-WoW64 (no glibc32), and -Wl,-z,max-page-size=0x4000

packages.name: gcc-libs
packages.license: GPL-3.0-or-later WITH GCC Runtime Library Exception (the libgcc_s runtime is distributable under the exception)
packages.role: MANDATORY: libgcc_s.so.1 is a load-time DT_NEEDED of ntdll.so (Wine's core NTDLL, always loaded). Non-optional.
packages.build_recipe: gpkg/gcc-libs/build.sh (termux-pacman/glibc-packages upd-gcc branch, commit 845d0e313f53535de28abba0fb42b07e960cc031; supersedes the c9d4de5 main pin for this package — gcc 14.2.1 does not build with the cgct image's gcc 16.1.0 cross-compiler due to C++20 char8_t)

packages.name: libx11
packages.role: MANDATORY: Wine winex11.drv dlopens libX11.so.6 at unix-lib init and NtTerminateProcess'es if it fails. Required for any window.

packages.name: libxcb
packages.role: X11 C Binding (transitive dep of libX11).

packages.name: libxau
packages.role: X11 Authorization Protocol (transitive dep of libxcb).

packages.name: libxdmcp
packages.role: X11 Display Manager Control Protocol (transitive dep of libxcb).

packages.name: libxext
packages.role: X11 Extensions (transitive dep of libX11; Wine dlopens it for the X11 extension path).

packages.name: freetype
packages.role: MANDATORY: Wine font rendering. Kron4ek does not pass --without-freetype, so libfreetype.so.6 is in the DT_NEEDED of gdi32.

packages.name: fontconfig
packages.role: MANDATORY: Wine font selection (pulled by freetype). Kron4ek does not pass --without-fontconfig.

packages.name: zlib
packages.role: MANDATORY transitive runtime dependency of libfreetype.so.6.

packages.name: libbz2
packages.role: MANDATORY transitive runtime dependency of libfreetype.so.6.

packages.name: libpng
packages.role: MANDATORY transitive runtime dependency of libfreetype.so.6.

packages.name: brotli
packages.role: MANDATORY transitive runtime dependency of libfreetype.so.6.

packages.name: libexpat
packages.role: MANDATORY transitive runtime dependency of libfontconfig.so.1.

packages.name: xorg-util-macros
packages.role: BUILD-ONLY: Autotools macros used by the X11 closure; no runtime ELF is distributed.

packages.name: xorgproto
packages.role: BUILD-ONLY: X11 protocol headers and pkg-config metadata; no runtime ELF is distributed.

packages.name: xtrans
packages.role: BUILD-ONLY: transport headers required to source-build libX11; no runtime ELF is distributed.

packages.name: xcb-proto
packages.role: BUILD-ONLY: XML XCB protocol descriptions required to source-build libxcb; no runtime ELF is distributed.

packages.name: alsa-lib
packages.role: O23 OPTIONAL (audio): libasound.so.2 is the DT_NEEDED of winealsa.so and of the android_aserver PCM plugin. Absent is fine for audio-off (the default); present enables the O23 audio backend when audioMode=on. Built on demand: python tools/build_glibc_closure.py --packages alsa-lib

intentionally_absent_optional.note: These are dlopen-disablable or --without-* optional deps. Absent is fine for the WineD3D-safe audio-off spike; Wine degrades silently. Adding any (esp. libGL/libEGL/Mesa for WineD3D, or libvulkan for DXVK) is a deliberate re-planning decision that must extend this lockfile.
libs: libvulkan.so.1 (GAP in glibc-packages; --without-vulkan sidesteps for O06)
libpulse.so.0 (audio off; libasound.so.2 is now O23-conditional — build alsa-lib for the audio backend)

verification.closure_checker: tools/check_wine_dtneeded.py derives the actual transitive DT_NEEDED + WINE_CHECK_SONAME dlopen set from the pinned Wine archive and cross-checks every mandatory SONAME against this lockfile; the spike does not proceed with an unmet mandatory dep.
verification.build_script: tools/build_glibc_closure.py builds the closure from the pinned commit, applies the shared 0x4000 maximum-page-size linker policy, and hashes every imported package in runtime/glibc-rootfs-x86_64/BUILD_PROVENANCE.json.
verification.page_size_gate: tools/stage_wine_runtime.py parses every staged ELF64 program header and fails unless every PT_LOAD is 16 KB aligned and offset/address congruent.
